Name: Faster Trees
Author: Krutonium
Description: Adds a user configurable chance each day to make all trees progress to the next stage of growth. For example, with perfect luck (or 100% chance) your trees would go from a seed to fully grown in 5 days. This doesn't negate the games own internal chance for a tree to grow, so it's technically possible for a tree to progress by 2 stages in one night, though unlikely.

Manifest.Name: FasterTrees
Manifest.Description: Make Trees grow on average the number of days you choose.
Manifest.Author: Krutonium
